svg.title: Traditional agent harnesses couple the UI, runtime and models into one vendor stack. Mecatl keeps the engine loop constant and lets you choose all three.
svg.desc: Left: a single sealed slab labelled Theirs, containing three fused layers - their UI, their runtime, their models - sharing one cord, captioned "One vendor, top to bottom." Right: a panel labelled Yours with three separate cards, each with its own cord and its own connector down into a central bar reading "the constant: Mecatl engine loop". The cards are Client (any UI: mecatui, your app, TypeScript SDK), Runtime (anywhere: local, remote, Kubernetes) and Models (any provider: Anthropic, OpenAI, OpenRouter or yours). Captioned "Swap any layer. The loop stays." Mecatito, the Mecatl mascot - a Xoloitzcuintli puppy in a teal rope collar - sits in the lower right, overhanging the engine loop bar.

text.tspan: Swap any layer. The loop stays.
